message:
Blog slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters, so "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes, all 3 tests.

I made the fix in `src/blog/slug.js`. It strips accents from the title before passing it to `slugify`. I didn't change `vendor/slugify`, because it's marked "do not edit by hand". The shop's `productUrl` also uses it, so shop URLs still drop accented letters. Product names with accents would hit the same bug. If you want that fixed too, the same one-line change would go in `src/shop/product-url.js`.
